entities.name: Len Taunyane
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Len Taunyane was a track and field athlete from the Orange River Colony who competed in the 1904 Summer Olympics in the Men's marathon, and was therefore one of the first two black Africans to participate in the modern Olympic Games.
